correction: A member's own organization's notifications are a personal/team inbox (quotation sent, rental active, invoice issued, etc.), not admin configuration — requiring the broadest admin permission meant no one but an owner could ever see them, silently (the NotificationBell component already catches its own fetch failures and just shows an empty bell, so this was invisible in the UI, only visible in network tab 403s). Fixed with a new PermissionService.requireActiveMembership (any active member of the org, still respects org suspension, no permission-code check at all) used instead of requirePermission(..., 'organization.manage').
